scripts.dev:pathway: concurrently -n pathway-server,pathway-web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @wob/pathway-server" "npm run dev -w @wob/pathway-web"
scripts.build:pathway: npm run build -w @wob/pathway-core && npm run build -w @wob/pathway-server && npm run build -w @wob/pathway-web
